metadata.description: Independently versioned offices for irreversible or production-facing work, sharing the office-core protocol, plus a router office that selects among them.

plugins.name: codex-office
plugins.description: Codex office. The active Codex session plans and closes out; fresh codex exec sessions execute and adversarially review.

plugins.name: claude-office
plugins.description: Claude office. Planner interviews to 95% clarity, a Sonnet executor implements, a fresh Opus reviewer adversarially gates on evidence.

plugins.name: agy-office
plugins.description: Agy office. The agy CLI executes, the planner independently verifies in a mandatory Phase 2b, and a non-agy reviewer holds the gate.

plugins.name: auto-office
plugins.description: Auto office. Routes each unit of work to a codex, agy, or claude executor by capability and measured quota, gates the plan before user approval, then runs goal-locked end-to-end to closeout behind an Opus code-review gate.
